item.title: Ask HN: What should I do with my W10 laptop?
item.summary: I have a laptop that has everything you need for it, it might be my favorite laptop, but I upgraded since W10 support ended, and I WFH so just bought the same laptop, newer model. The W10 is great. I’m thinking use it as a daily journal, add music production software , or possibly use as a nice compact gaming monitor. Any other ideas?
